diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers.this` registers the autoscaling capacity providers on the ECS cluster, but it has no dependency on `:resource.aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this`. ECS only accepts a capacity provider association once the capacity provider exists and is ACTIVE, so on a fresh apply the cluster-capacity-provider association can race ahead of capacity provider creation and fail with "The specified capacity provider does not exist". Although `local.cluster_capacity_providers` merges in `aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this`, the graph shows no edge, so the ordering isn't guaranteed. Wire the capacity providers into `capacity_providers` (deriving the names from the resource rather than from the input variable) so Terraform infers the ordering.

fix.expression:
distinct(concat(
    [for k, v in var.fargate_capacity_providers : try(v.name, k)],
    [for k, v in aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this : try(v.name, k)]
  ))
